subject: Assamese
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Reading in CBSE Class 11 Assamese.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Assamese (114), Unit-1: Reading covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
